approach_why: An interim leadership role: the buyer pays for a plan, so the letter opens with one.

paragraphs.text: If I joined as your interim VP of Engineering, this is how I would start.

list.text: Map how code reaches production for every team and remove the manual steps, as I did when I cut release lead time at Acme from 10 days to under one day.
Set service level objectives and error budgets with each team lead, the approach that brought the incident rate at Globex down 45%.
Agree a quarterly plan and its goals with product leadership, the way I have run planning before.

paragraphs.text: I have led this work at scale. I grew Acme engineering from 12 to 45 engineers across six teams, and at Globex I led four managers and 60 engineers.
Happy to walk through the plan on a call.
